files.summary: reconcile delivered families and authoring adapters without closing broader gates
edits:
- [x] **BASE-1 — Existing finite admission:** `packages/domain/src/declarations.ts` validates candidates through installed world-owned families, deduplicates mechanics, commits definition/recipe records and records admission. The bundled catalogue includes sling, bow, arrow, gathering-tool, woven-container and manufactured-cordage families. NP03 admits certified cordage as a woven-container binding input; this finite composition does not authorize arbitrary mechanics or generated inputs for every family.
The original four recipe families—sling, bow, arrow and gathering tool—now have the PW03 woven-container and NP03 manufactured-cordage families alongside them. The [playable-week designs](../projects/parallel-batch-01-playable-week-tech-design.md#pw02--family-definitions-not-engine-recipe-switches) and [PW02 work](parallel-batch-01-playable-week.md#pw02--world-owned-invention-families-and-one-admission-path) own the delivered world-family admission boundary and remaining integration qualification. PW03 supplies native compilation/crafting, PostgreSQL teaching/custody/restart and scripted ordinary Craft evidence; NP03 supplies the exact manufactured-binding dependency and consumption proof below. Those results do not establish arbitrary recursive composition, general live-law migration or live model generation/voluntary chain choice. Existing parent and release gates retain those distinct requirements.
  - [x] PW02 extracts the original four families into trusted authored descriptors with strict selected-family candidate schemas, native validators/compilers, exact installed family/dependency pins and shared presentation metadata. Four-family native craft/use and forged/stale current-state checks pass. The utility-container consumer is delivered under PW03, and NP03 adds manufactured binding reuse; remaining integrated creator/client checks stay in PW02/PW03 rather than requiring those families to be implemented again. Broader registration/composition remains open.
- [x] **4.11 Extend scoped tools to a concrete creator-owned definition kind.** Delivered for supported custom number/reservoir/category attributes through the current native definition owner, with application-bound creator scope, schema/inspection, immutable draft, comparison, native preview and exact reviewed Apply. INV-21.1 and WW05/WW14 add separate body attachment and value intervention; [local qualification](../verification/world-agent-context.md#custom-resource-follow-up) covers exact pins, native drain, stale-value refusal, privacy and current-format reopen. Current player-lock and payer rules remain enforced. This closes the first concrete attribute adapter, not sense/controller replacement, broad live-law migration or hosted qualification; those remain with WW10, INV-5 and WW07/WW11.
- [x] **6.3 Establish the shared native contribution protocol.** Read one start-state, aggregate competing resource claims, then atomically apply bounded contributions/transfers in stable order. Record time/random inputs. Enforce work and scheduled-descendant limits; no unbounded recursive updates or AI per tick.
- [ ] **7.3 Bound autonomous invention.** NPC goals/attention and meaningful blocked-action events may initiate requests under the agent lock. Coalesce compatible concurrent requests, use cooldowns/negative-result expiry and reserve cost before dispatch. Player delegation preserves player origin. Bodily consequences and admitted native actions do not wait on invention; meal and method choices remain with the current actor-agency policy, not a restored automatic food-seeking controller. Budget/deduplicate clarification and rejected-method episodes; actor memory, intentions and continuation remain [AG08](agent-agency.md#ag08--actor-side-invention-continuation-and-choice) work.
**Design owner:** [Invention foundation](../invention-foundation.md). **Depends on:** the delivered INV-1/2 request lineage and relevant INV-4.4/4.10 workshop interfaces. Work can start with the installed finite families; it does not wait for all remaining INV-1–INV-8 or for a general interpreter.
- [ ] **10.2 Separate stability controls.** Add immutable policy records for owner review/freeze and author no-automatic-refinement, independent of immutable artifact bytes, installation pins, origin locks and runtime quarantine. Enforce actual author/owner/operator/payer grants separately. Preserve current player/NPC defaults; the accepted creator/special-player authority target remains undelivered under INV-1.7/MP02, not an implicit runtime lock exception.
  - [x] Add a separate world-granted read/preview profile shared by local owner inspection and dedicated read-only MCP credentials. It does not filter administrative inspection by the controlled character's learned recipes or widen NPC tools. INV-21.1–21.3 subsequently deliver funded session contexts and reviewed mutation through the same service. Broader multi-user recipient grants and deployment qualification remain with MP02 and WW07/WW11.
  - [x] The original eight read/preview operations share strict descriptors for local HTTP and MCP. The current catalogue also includes schema, entity-directory and bounded trace reads; INV-21 adds the separate shared authoring descriptors and selected-kind submissions. The eight-tool bootstrap is historical scope, not the current tool count or a reason to introduce another registry/writer.
  - [x] Implement the disabled-by-default official SDK 2.0.0 server/Node adapter with bounded requests/results, per-request server state and stateless compatibility. Local real-SDK HTTP initialization/discovery/calls and subsequent real Macrofold forwarding are qualified within WW07's recorded local scope. Modern-profile and target-deployment qualification remain separate; the local overlay is not a deployable release by itself. SDK compatibility replies may use short SSE framing; no custom codec was added.
  - [x] Require an explicit credential hash, exact world ID, expiry and allowed Host list for the read-only server-to-server connector. Reject Origin/URL arguments, disabled/mismatched/expired scope and invalid credentials. Those credentials alone still grant no paid work or write authority. INV-21 now supplies opt-in mutation tools with separate application-issued session contexts and exact human approval; qualified deployment and broader grant lifecycles remain WW07/WW11 work.
- [ ] **16.5 Finish deployable connector and native-harness qualification.** INV-21.3 supplies the existing Macrofold provisioner/journals, selected tool-only owner workspace and attributable session/Run allocation; WW18–WW23 record local native interoperability. Complete WW07's reviewed-build, exact connector-grant and matching deployment requirements rather than provisioning a second harness. Preserve the explicit connection/tool ceiling, denied unrelated shell/files/connectors, scoped HTTPS endpoint, durable pre-dispatch mapping and uncertain-creation recovery. Do not disable private-network checks or expose all owner routes.
- [ ] **16.6 Qualify structured results and durable actions on the target deployment.** Shared MCP structuredContent/text envelopes, exact operation IDs, human-only approval and native Apply receipts are implemented under INV-21 and locally exercised under WW07. Preserve protocol errors versus application findings, bounded inspect/cancel recovery and the prohibition on new writes from unknown outcomes. Remaining target-build forwarding, cancellation/failure and long-job qualification stays with WW07/WW11; do not rebuild the delivered codec, receipt store or execution service.
- [ ] **16.7 Complete deployed interoperability evidence.** Reuse the recorded local real-SDK, native Macrofold, draft/review/Apply, private-body and restart evidence. WW07 owns the remaining exact deployable-build and matching-runtime gate, including affected discovery/read, supported non-recipe and question-continuation journeys, cancellation and reduced-scope fresh contexts. Retain any unperformed protocol/auth negative cases in their existing coverage owners. Injected envelopes cannot qualify native forwarding, and local live success cannot qualify a different deployment or erase historical accounting uncertainty.
- [x] **17.1 Deliver one non-recipe creator adapter.** The supported custom-attribute path is delivered through the current definition owner, separate add-only body attachment and revision-bound value intervention, with exact read/schema/draft/diff/native checks/review/Apply. [Custom-resource qualification](../verification/world-agent-context.md#custom-resource-follow-up) records native drain, stale-edit rejection, exact graph/definition evidence, private-body denial and current-PostgreSQL reopen; the following section records actual local discovery/definition/attachment journeys and their limitations. This is the same delivered slice as INV-4.11/INV-21 and WW05/WW14, not another adapter project. Sense/controller replacement, general live law changes and the two-unlike-example gate remain open.
- [ ] **18.2 Complete progressive review without duplicating the unified conversation.** INV-21.4 already delivers the action-capable World Agent conversation, exact draft/review/Apply state, retained turn results and free native shortcuts. The remaining low-impact approval policy and combined mechanics/art review depend on INV-9/INV-12/INV-21.6; current owner-workshop writes still require exact human review. Keep explicit backend action intent, and never interpret quoted instructions as permission. Do not reopen the delivered conversation implementation merely because those broader approval/art targets are unfinished.
Extend the installed finite invention families, supplied/actor proposal routes and current INV-21 World Agent sessions, selected drafts, native checks, review/Apply and root accounting. Complete remaining INV-1/2 acceptance and delegation without rebuilding those mechanisms or the NP03 manufactured-binding proof. INV-9/INV-11/INV-13 retain their broader independent-project, validation and funding requirements; INV-12 introduces art only for an actually supported family. INV-10 protection records remain separate from delivered origin locks, and indirect protection requires actual dependency/impact coverage.
The [branch audit](remaining-foundational-work.md#branch-coverage-snapshot) retains the historical `feature/invention-repertoire-foundation` lineage. Its finite authoring/revision/receipt adapters and the later world-family and shared native contribution foundations are integrated in the current source; that old branch name is not a remaining merge prerequisite. Preserve existing task IDs and receipts while completing general registration, live-state replacement and the named DF02 acceptance, rather than restarting delivered work from an outdated main-only summary.
